## Acceptance evidence

- [ ] Artifact is complete enough for the next dependent issue.
- [ ] Direct evidence and assumptions are distinguishable.
- [ ] Alternatives and trade-offs are recorded where material.
- [ ] Cross-document conflicts are reconciled.
- [ ] Decisions and ADRs are updated where required.
- [ ] Remaining uncertainty is explicit.
